description: Polyphonic oscillator built on a trapezoid whose rising and falling edges you set separately, with two outputs and a hard sync

params.text: Sets the pitch in semitones either side of C4, four octaves each way, reading out in Hz
Tilts the shape of the wave, 0 to 1
Sets how much of each cycle the wave spends rising, a fortieth of it at the bottom of the travel and a fifth at the top
Sets how much of each cycle the wave spends falling, a fortieth of it at the bottom of the travel and a fifth at the top
Attenuates and inverts the FM input before it reaches the pitch, -1 to +1, with a squared response so small settings move the pitch very little

inputs.text: Pitch input tracking one volt per octave, added to the pitch set by the frequency knob; the number of channels here sets the number of channels the module runs
Shifts the tilt, 5V covering the whole of that knob's travel, with the total held inside it
Shifts the rising time, 5V covering the whole of that knob's travel, with the total held inside it
Shifts the falling time, 5V covering the whole of that knob's travel, with the total held inside it
Modulates the pitch, scaled by the FM knob
A rising edge here restarts the cycle

outputs.text: The oscillator swinging either side of zero, ±5V
The oscillator swinging one way only, 0-5V

notes: the module runs as many channels as the pitch input carries, and one channel when nothing is patched there.
